blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Sandiganbayan Third Division on Tuesday announced that it has junked the move of former Sen. Bong Revilla to bar its chairperson, Associate Justice Karl Miranda — the sole judge who denied his bail — from participating in the trial of his malversation case. In a resolution dated Sept. 24, the anti-graft court denied Revilla’s second Motion for Inhibition to prevent Miranda from participating in the trial of the former senator and six of his co-accused stemming from an alleged ghost flood control project of the Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) in Pandi, Bulacan worth P92.8 million. “The court […]...
